postconditions.description: If n is zero or negative, the function returns an empty string.
For positive n, all lines in the returned pattern have the same length, equal to the length of the longest line.
postconditions.expression: n > 0 and all(len(line) == len(return_value.splitlines()[-1]) for line in return_value.splitlines())

postconditions.description: For positive n, the pattern has exactly (2n - 1) lines.

For positive n, the first n lines form an ascending pyramid where each line k (1 ≤ k ≤ n) is constructed as the concatenation of numbers from 1 to k followed by numbers from (k - 1) down to 1. The remaining (n - 1) lines form a descending pyramid where each line k (n + 1 ≤ k ≤ 2n - 1) mirrors the corresponding line (2n - k) from the ascending half.
postconditions.expression: n > 0 and all(line == ''.join(str(i) for i in range(1, k + 1)) + ''.join(str(i) for i in range(k - 1, 0, -1)) for k, line in enumerate(return_value.splitlines(), 1) if k <= n) and all(line == return_value.splitlines()[2 * n - k] for k in range(n + 1, 2 * n))
